title: View token usage for dashboard-launched Codex tasks

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-357#view-token-usage-for-dashboard-launched-tasks ("View token usage for dashboard-launched Codex tasks"), revision caa6ca1bdd554ea8ff55423ba7226657539c7519 (implementation through 8c8d35d4).

Verdict: Caught.

Promise (story, Required restrictions and Coverage): partial and unpriced tasks stay out of the moving average; a partial task keeps a distinct point but does not enter the trailing 10-task average, and fewer than 10 eligible tasks draw no line.

Fault: dashboard/server/tokenIndexCohort.ts, in tokenIndexCohort, the eligibility filter
  - const eligible = tasks.filter((task) => task.coverage.kind === "measured");
  + const eligible = tasks;
so partial tasks enter the moving-average windows. Fixtures and assertions untouched.

Maintained checks: dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/token-index-eligibility.spec.ts test 2 (average equality, line 180); e2e/configuration/system-settings-usage-coverage.spec.ts via usage.showsNoAverage("Fewer than 10 eligible tasks") (dashboard/tests/support/systemSettingsUsagePage.ts:116).

Commands (scratch checkout at the selected revision):
  env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/token-index-eligibility.spec.ts --reporter=list --workers=2
  env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/configuration/system-settings-usage-coverage.spec.ts --reporter=list --workers=2
  Witness: temporary scratch backend spec (10 measured tasks plus one partial task).

Observations: baseline both passed and exercised the partial path. Witness unfaulted: one average entry; faulted: two (the partial task completes its own window). Faulted backend test 2 failed at line 180 (five average entries instead of one); faulted e2e failed in showsNoAverage (readout "14,540" instead of "—"). Not probed: a partial leak elsewhere (the client reads answer.average from the server; none exists at this revision).

Restoration: fault reverted under a shell trap, witness deleted, scratch state clean, restored reruns passed (backend 2, e2e 1); scratch worktree removed. Selected checkout not edited.

Next proof action: none required for this promise on the probed path; keep both maintained checks. Known gaps (byte/page stability of repeated store writes; conflicting-tier pricing) are owned by the planned correction (plan 630) and were not probed.

Cost: about 26 s of runner time; invocation-to-report elapsed 124538 ms. Human and agent effort unavailable.

## Wrap-up disposition

- Checked revision: caa6ca1bdd554ea8ff55423ba7226657539c7519.
- Evidence: verdict Caught by token-index-eligibility.spec.ts:180 and the coverage journey's showsNoAverage.
- Decision: no action; keep both maintained checks. No new follow-up. The retrospective correction SEED-357#reuse-unchanged-usage-pages-on-repeated-writes (plan 630) remains first in the backlog and owns the known gaps the check did not probe.
